name: Decodo
summary: Decodo's Web Data API: scrape a page or a supported site's template, Google results, crawl a site up to 10,000 pages, or map its URLs.

api_key.description: A Web Data API key from dashboard.decodo.com. Legacy Web Scraping API and Fast Search API tokens do not work here. Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

notes: Billed per 1,000 successful requests; failures on Decodo's side (500, 524, 613) are not charged.
/scrape defaults to the premium proxy pool and its higher rate: set proxy_pool standard for simple pages. Any headless value is billed at the + JS rate.
Every call here is a read sent as POST with a JSON body, except the status and result reads.
Decodo's proxy networks and the residential Public API (sub-users, whitelisted IPs) are not in this entry; nor are batch tasks or crawl cancellation.

endpoints.name: Scrape a page
endpoints.summary: A page's HTML, Markdown, screenshot or parsed data, or a supported site through a target template, in the same response.

url.description: The page to scrape. Required unless the target template takes query instead.

query.description: The query, for target templates that take one (e.g. google_search) instead of url.

target.description: A target template for a supported site, e.g. google_search; see the Templates Overview page.

proxy_pool.description: standard for simple pages; premium (default) for anti-bot sites and target templates. Premium costs more.

headless.description: html renders JavaScript; png returns a screenshot. Either is billed at the + JS rate.

markdown.description: Return the page as Markdown. Default false.

parse.description: Return structured data, for target templates with a dedicated parser. Default false.

geo.description: Location: a full country name in Capital Case (United States) or an uppercase 2-letter code (US).

domain.description: Top-level domain for templates, e.g. com, co.uk. Default com.

session_id.description: Reuse the same IP across requests for up to 10 minutes.

headers.description: Headers for the target request; forwarded only with force_headers true.

force_headers.description: Forward the headers you sent to the target. Default false.

successful_status_codes.description: Target HTTP codes to treat as success and return content for, e.g. [404].

notes: A read over POST. Give url, or query with a target template that takes one.
Supported parameters vary slightly by target template.

endpoints.name: Search Google
endpoints.summary: Parsed Google results for a query: organic, top stories, people also ask, related searches and the answer box.

geo.description: Country, as a full name or 2-letter code. An unrecognized value silently falls back to the US.

uule.description: Google UULE location string; wins over geo.

gl.description: 2-letter country code; geo wins over it.

notes: A read over POST. Compare search_parameters.gl with your geo to confirm it was recognized.
status is done even when organic is empty.

endpoints.name: Map a site's URLs
endpoints.summary: The URLs on a page and in the site's top-level sitemap (up to 147K), without scraping content.

url.description: The page to discover URLs from.

sitemap.description: include (default) both, only the sitemap, or skip it.

select_paths.description: Regex patterns; only matching URL paths are returned.

exclude_paths.description: Regex patterns; matching URL paths are left out.

domain_filter.description: domain (default), subdomain, or all including external sites.

JS_rendering.description: Render JavaScript before collecting links (premium + JS rate). Default false.

geo.description: Country to send the request from.

notes: A read over POST. Billed one request for the page plus one for the sitemap when it is included.
Nested sitemaps are not followed; with a sitemap index, only returns 400.

endpoints.name: Start a crawl
endpoints.summary: Crawl a site from a URL, up to 10,000 pages, as Markdown or HTML, in the background.

limit.description: Maximum pages to scrape, 1-10000. Each page is billed as one request.

max_depth.description: Maximum link hops from the start URL.

sitemap.description: include (default), only, or skip the sitemap.

select_paths.description: Regex patterns; only matching paths are crawled.

exclude_paths.description: Regex patterns; matching paths are skipped.

max_duration.description: Seconds before the crawl stops as truncated.

JS_retry.description: Retry a failed page once with JavaScript, at the + JS rate.

locale.description: Accept-Language sent to sites, e.g. en-US.

notes: A read over POST that starts a billed job: returns 202 with crawl_id. Set limit to keep the cost predictable.

endpoints.name: Get crawl status
endpoints.summary: A crawl's state and counts of completed, failed and in-flight pages.
notes: status is pending, done, cancelled, truncated or faulted.

endpoints.name: Get crawl results
endpoints.summary: Every crawled URL with its status and task id, or with type=content the page content inline.

type.description: content returns the scraped content inline; omit for the URL list with task ids.

notes: Without type=content, fetch each page with task.results and its task id.

endpoints.name: Queue an async scrape
endpoints.summary: Submit a /scrape request to run in the background and get a task id.

url.description: The page to scrape. Required unless the target template takes query instead.

query.description: The query, for target templates that take one (e.g. google_search) instead of url.

target.description: A target template for a supported site, e.g. google_search; see the Templates Overview page.

proxy_pool.description: standard for simple pages; premium (default) for anti-bot sites and target templates. Premium costs more.

headless.description: html renders JavaScript; png returns a screenshot. Either is billed at the + JS rate.

markdown.description: Return the page as Markdown. Default false.

parse.description: Return structured data, for target templates with a dedicated parser. Default false.

geo.description: Location: a full country name in Capital Case (United States) or an uppercase 2-letter code (US).

domain.description: Top-level domain for templates, e.g. com, co.uk. Default com.

session_id.description: Reuse the same IP across requests for up to 10 minutes.

headers.description: Headers for the target request; forwarded only with force_headers true.

force_headers.description: Forward the headers you sent to the target. Default false.

successful_status_codes.description: Target HTTP codes to treat as success and return content for, e.g. [404].

callback_url.description: URL Decodo POSTs the task id and status to when done (not the result).

notes: A read over POST. For slow pages or large volumes; takes the same parameters as scrape.

endpoints.name: Get async scrape result
endpoints.summary: The result of a queued scrape task.

task_id.description: The task id from task.create or a crawl's results.
